description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'MappingStrategies' that manages a collection of JSON-based mapping strategies used for cluster communication and persistence within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for loading strategies based on configuration and retrieving specific strategies by key.

classes.name: MappingStrategies
classes.description: An immutable abstract class managing mapping strategies for JSONParsable elements associated with type names, supporting loading from ActorSystem configuration and strategy retrieval by key.

methods.name: loadMappingStrategies
methods.description: Loads the MappingStrategies implementation dynamically based on configuration within the provided ActorSystem.

methods.name: getMappingStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the strategy associated with a given key.
